title: Pointwise left derived functors give a right Kan extension
statement: Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal H$ be a functor between categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $W$ be a morphism property on $\mathcal C$, and let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a localization functor for $W$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If $F$ has a pointwise left derived functor at every object of $\mathcal C$ (equivalently, a pointwise right Kan extension along $L$ at every object), then $F$ has a left derived functor with respect to $W$: there is a functor $LF:\mathcal D\to\mathcal H$ and a natural transformation $LF\circ L\to F$ exhibiting a right Kan extension of $F$ along $L$, hence satisfying the universal property of a left derived functor.
